basic_details.job_title: NITT Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Project Assistant / Project Associate II Posts
basic_details.short_information: One project position - Project Assistant or Project Associate-II - is open in the Department of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering at the National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli (NITT), for the project "Development of new material for Bucket Wheel Teeth and its life improvement" funded by NLC India Limited (NLCIL). The position runs for 3 months and will be renewed up to 03/12/2027, with pay of Rs.27,000 (Project Assistant) or Rs.33,000 (Project Associate-II) plus 18% HRA. Applications from Indian Nationals, in the prescribed format, must be sent by post or courier to the Princi

post_wise_breakdown.pay: Project Assistant: Rs.27000/+ 18% HRA; Project Associate-II: Rs.33,000/+ 18% HRA

how_to_apply: Fill in the application only in the prescribed format (Form No. 8, attached to the notice) and paste a recent passport size colour photograph on it.
Attach your Bio-Data and supporting documents (listed below).
Mark the subject on the application as NITT/R&C/716/SPK/MPR/2.
Send the application by post/courier to: Dr.S.P.Kumaresh Babu, Professor, Dept. of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli – 620015.
Send a soft copy to [email protected].
Make sure the application is submitted by 19.11.2026.
Experience certificate (experience including research, industrial field and others)
Photocopies of qualifying degree certificates and mark sheets/grade cards from HSC onwards (self-attested)
Copies of published or unpublished research work, if any
Proof of past study as a sponsored candidate, or other contractual obligation, if any

The form also asks for details of two areas the candidate must disclose: any relatives associated with NIT Tiruchirappalli, and any current or past association with the institute as student or project staff. It ends with a declaration that false information may lead to forfeiture of the appointment and legal action.

NLCIL and NIT Tiruchirappalli, with field visits to mines

content_sections.heading: About NITT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice was issued on 5 November 2026 by the Office of the Dean (R & C), NIT Tiruchi, for consultancy / research projects under the principal investigator Dr.S.P.Kumaresh Babu of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering at the National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu. The project being staffed is "Development of new material for Bucket Wheel Teeth and its life improvement", with NLC India Limited (NLCIL) as the funding agency.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice offers one position in total, which is advertised as Project Assistant/Project Associate-II. Pay depends on which of the two posts the selected candidate is engaged in.

rows.pay: Project Assistant: Rs.27000/+ 18% HRA; Project Associate-II: Rs.33,000/+ 18% HRA

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals may apply. The upper age limit is 42 years, with relaxation based on the Government norms; the notice prints no cut-off date for counting age. Candidates must make sure they are eligible for the position they intend to apply for before appearing for the interview. Essential: Bachelor's Degree in Science (B.Sc.) or a three-year Diploma in Engineering and Technology. Desirable: B.Sc. in Chemistry/Materials Science or a three-year Diploma in Mechanical/Metallurgical/Materials Engineering. Age: upper age limit 42 years, relaxation based on Government norms. Essential: B.E./B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or Production Engineering. Experience: two years of experience in R&D in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations, including scientific activities and services. Desirable: M.E./M.Tech. in Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering or any other relevant specialization from an AICTE/MHRD-recognized Institute/University. Age: upper age limit 42 years, relaxation based on Government norms. The application form also asks for a GATE/NET score, if any, previous research work and publications, and any past association with NIT Tiruchirappalli. Candidates should check the official notification for the full discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: B.E./B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or Production Engineering, with two years of R&D experience (see below)
rows.desirable: M.E./M.Tech. in a listed specialization (see below)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are Rs.27,000 for the Project Assistant and Rs.33,000 for the Project Associate-II, with 18% HRA in addition in both cases. The engagement is for 3 months and, as printed, "will be renewed Upto 03/12/2027". The application form describes the posts as temporary project staff. Quarters for stay at NLCIL will be provided.

content_sections.heading: NITT Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice gives one job description for the project staff: Performing experiments and project related administrative work. Working both at NLCIL and NITT. At NLCIL, working hours are 8.00 am to 5.00 pm (six working days). Visiting mines for field work whenever it is required.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NITT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application only in the prescribed format (Form No. 8, attached to the notice) and paste a recent passport size colour photograph on it. Attach your Bio-Data and supporting documents (listed below). Mark the subject on the application as NITT/R&C/716/SPK/MPR/2 . Send the application by post/courier to: Dr.S.P.Kumaresh Babu, Professor, Dept. of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli – 620015. Send a soft copy to [email protected] . Make sure the application is submitted by 19.11.2026. The form also asks for details of two areas the candidate must disclose: any relatives associated with NIT Tiruchirappalli, and any current or past association with the institute as student or project staff. It ends with a declaration that false information may lead to forfeiture of the appointment and legal action.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice refers to an interview for the position. Candidates must bring their original certificates at the time of the interview for verification. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NITT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 (one position), advertised as Project Assistant/Project Associate-II.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the duly filled application is 19 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's Degree in Science (B.Sc.) or a three-year Diploma in Engineering and Technology; a B.Sc. in Chemistry/Materials Science or a Diploma in Mechanical/Metallurgical/Materials Engineering is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: B.E./B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or Production Engineering, with two years of R&D experience in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 42 years, with relaxation based on the Government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant gets Rs.27,000 and the Project Associate-II gets Rs.33,000, each with 18% HRA in addition.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice adds 18% HRA to the emoluments of both posts.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the prescribed application with Bio-Data and documents by post/courier to Dr.S.P.Kumaresh Babu, Dept. of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, NIT Tiruchirappalli – 620015, with subject NITT/R&C/716/SPK/MPR/2, and send a soft copy to [email protected].

faq.question: Q9. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: The duration is 3 months, and it will be renewed up to 03/12/2027.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the selected candidate work?
faq.answer: The project staff work at both NLCIL and NITT, with field visits to mines when required; at NLCIL the hours are 8.00 am to 5.00 pm over six working days, and quarters are provided.
